name: Alembic Pharmaceuticals Ltd
tagline: A mid-cap pharma with a historically cyclical US business now showing a real Q1 FY27 inflection (+49% YoY), on top of a genuinely secular non-US growth engine tracked in exhaustive detail by a trusted user
business_overview: Alembic Pharma spans oral solids, injectables (general and oncology), dermatology, ophthalmology, and API manufacturing across 9 facilities, with a growing domestic branded-generics franchise (5,200+ medical reps, new Gynac/Cardiac divisions), a fast-growing animal healthcare segment (~24% CAGR over recent years), and a US generics business that management itself describes as prone to 'bouts of good growth followed by stagnation.'
fundamentals_table: ROCE ~13% (3-yr ~13%) / ROE ~13.4% - flat and below the >=15% bar
FY26 revenue Rs 7,345 Cr (+10%), PAT Rs 671 Cr; gross borrowings Rs 1,430 Cr (up from Rs 1,258 Cr); FY26 CFO Rs 783 Cr; dividend payout ~35%
Revenue +25.66% YoY to Rs 2,150 Cr; PAT +12.01% to Rs 175 Cr; US Formulations +49% YoY (Rs 523 Cr → Rs 778 Cr)
fundamentals_narrative: Trailing quality metrics are moderate rather than exceptional — ROE (12.7% 3-yr) and ROCE (14.66%) both trail peers like Ajanta Pharma in this same batch, and 5-year sales growth has been poor (6.37%), largely reflecting a choppy US business under sustained pricing pressure. However, Q1 FY27 (quarter ended June 2026) shows a real, specific inflection: consolidated revenue +25.66% YoY, EBITDA pre-R&D margin at 24%, and — most notably — the US Formulations segment (the exact segment harsh.beria93's multi-year notes had flagged as 'cyclical/stagnant') surged 49% YoY to Rs 778 Cr, with management upgrading FY27 revenue guidance to mid-teens. This is one quarter of data, not yet a confirmed new trend, but it directly updates the trailing narrative rather than just restating it. Gross borrowings have also risen (Rs 589 Cr from Rs 430 Cr) to fund ongoing capex (new Pithampur facility, peptide-manufacturing API block).
